prompt:
A content-moderation system must decide whether a social-media comment is hate speech: a comment that attacks or demeans a group, or a person because they belong to a group, defined by race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or national origin. It sees only the comment text.

Write exactly 13 yes/no questions about a comment that a careful reader could answer from the comment text alone, and whose answers would help decide whether the comment is hate speech. Do not mention any dataset, survey or annotation scheme. Return a JSON object mapping a short snake_case id to each question.
reply:
```json
{
  "mentions_group": "Does the comment reference a race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or national origin?",
  "targets_individual_as_group_member": "Does the comment attack or demean a specific person because of their membership in such a group?",
  "targets_whole_group": "Does the comment attack, demean, or insult an entire group defined by one of these characteristics?",
  "uses_slur": "Does the comment use a slur or derogatory term commonly directed at members of such a group?",
  "dehumanizing_language": "Does the comment compare members of the group to animals, vermin, disease, filth, or otherwise dehumanize them?",
  "calls_for_violence_or_harm": "Does the comment call for or wish violence, harm, or exclusion against the group or a member of it?",
  "generalizes_negative_traits": "Does the comment claim that all or most members of the group share a negative trait or behavior?",
  "expresses_superiority_or_inferiority": "Does the comment state or imply that the group is inferior or superior to another group?",
  "uses_stereotype": "Does the comment invoke a common negative stereotype about the group?",
  "hostile_or_contemptuous_tone": "Does the comment use an insulting, hostile, or contemptuous tone toward the group or individual?",
  "denies_rights_or_legitimacy": "Does the comment suggest the group does not deserve equal rights, dignity, or existence?",
  "context_is_clearly_non_hateful": "Does the comment appear to be quoting, reporting, condemning, or discussing hate speech rather than expressing it itself?",
  "criticism_limited_to_idea_or_policy": "Is the comment's criticism aimed only at an idea, policy, or institution rather than at a group of people or their identity?"
}
```
